name: dreamer
description: dreamer — a fast-path sprint plugin behind three commands: /dreamer:init, /dreamer:plan and /dreamer:execute.

plugins.name: dreamer
plugins.description: Three commands over one repo: /dreamer:init audits and slims your Claude config in one measured pass, /dreamer:plan turns a goal into a contract-valid stamped plan, and /dreamer:execute drives that plan to a merged commit with a TDD spine. Keeps the invariant gates, drops the process ceremony; the plan contract stays interoperable with crewforge5.
